name: io.github.handset-hq/handset
description: A business phone system for AI agents: send texts, place calls, read transcripts, buy numbers.

environmentVariables.name: HANDSET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Handset API key. Use a test-mode key (hs_test_…) — simulated carrier, free. Live keys are refused unless HANDSET_ALLOW_LIVE=1.

environmentVariables.name: HANDSET_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit a live-mode key (the agent can then text and call real people at real cost).
